translations.idiomatic: Later the Court of Imperial Sacrifices petitioned again, and the emperor ordered ritual officials to confer with Zhang Cong.

sentences.zh: 璁言：「樂舞以佾數爲降殺，不聞以武文爲偏全。

translations.literal: Cong said: "Dance formations are graded by the number of dancers, not by taking martial or civil as complete or partial.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cong said: "Dance is graded by the number of performers, not by treating martial and civil as partial sets.

sentences.zh: 使八佾之制，用其文而去其武，則兩階之容，得其左而闕其右。

translations.literal: If the eight-rows system used only the civil and discarded the martial, the image on the two staircases would have its left but lack its right.
translations.idiomatic: If eight rows used only civil dance and dropped martial, the two staircases would show the left side and lack the right.

sentences.zh: 是皇上舉天子禮樂，而自降殺之矣。

translations.literal: " This would mean His Majesty performing the Son of Heaven's ritual music yet lowering it himself.
translations.idiomatic: That would mean the Son of Heaven's own ritual music reduced by his own hand."

sentences.zh: 」乃從璁議，仍用二舞。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed Cong and still used both dances.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed Zhang Cong and kept both dances.

sentences.zh: 九年二月，始祈谷於南郊。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 9 prayer for grain began at the southern suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 9 prayer for grain began at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 帝親制樂章，命太常協於音譜。

translations.literal: The emperor personally composed hymn texts and ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to harmonize them to the musical score.
translations.idiomatic: He composed hymns himself and ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to set them to score.

sentences.zh: 是年，始祀先蠶，下禮官議樂舞。

translations.literal: That year sacrifice to the Sericulture Spirit began; ritual officials were ordered to deliberate on music and dance.
translations.idiomatic: That year sacrifice to the Sericulture Spirit began, and ritual officials were ordered to fix music and dance.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「先蠶之祀，周、漢所同。

translations.literal: The ritual officials said: "Sacrifice to the Sericulture Spirit was shared by Zhou and Han.
translations.idiomatic: They said: "Sacrifice to the Sericulture Spirit was shared by Zhou and Han.

sentences.zh: 其樂舞儀節，經史不載。

translations.literal: Its music and dance protocol is not recorded in the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: Its music and dance are not recorded in the classics.

sentences.zh: 唐開元先蠶儀注，大樂令設宮縣於北郊壇壝內，諸女工鹹列於後，則祀先蠶用女樂可知。

translations.literal: The Tang Kaiyuan Sericulture Spirit protocol has the Director of Music set palace bells inside the northern suburban altar enclosure, with all women workers arrayed behind—thus female music for the Sericulture Spirit is knowable.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Kaiyuan regulations place palace bells inside the northern suburban enclosure with women workers behind—so female music is indicated.

sentences.zh: 《唐六典》，宮縣之舞八佾，軒縣之舞六佾，則祀先蠶用八佾又可知。

translations.literal: *Tang liudian* states palace-bell dance uses eight rows and hall-bell dance six rows—thus eight rows for the Sericulture Spirit is also knowable.
translations.idiomatic: *Tang Institutions* gives eight rows for palace bells and six for hall bells—so eight rows for this sacrifice is also indicated.

sentences.zh: 然止言舞生冠服，而不及舞女冠服。

translations.literal: Yet it speaks only of dancers' caps and dress, not of female dancers' caps and dress.
translations.idiomatic: Yet it names only male dancers' dress, not female dancers'.

sentences.zh: 陳暘《樂書享先蠶圖》下，止有《宮架登歌圖》，而不及舞。

translations.literal: Under Chen Yang's *Music Book*, in the diagram for offering to the Sericulture Spirit there is only the *Palace Frame Elevated Singing Diagram*, not dance.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yang's *Music Book* shows elevated singing for the Sericulture Spirit but not dance.

sentences.zh: 夫有樂有舞，雖祀禮之常，然周、漢制度既不可考，宋祀先蠶，代以有司，又不可據。

translations.literal: Though music and dance are normal in sacrifice, Zhou and Han systems cannot be verified, and Song sacrifice to the Sericulture Spirit used officials in place—also not to be relied on.
translations.idiomatic: Music and dance are normal in sacrifice, but Zhou and Han cannot be verified and Song used officials in place—none may be relied on.

sentences.zh: 惟開元略爲近古，而陳氏《樂書》考據亦明。

translations.literal: Only Kaiyuan is somewhat near antiquity, and Chen's *Music Book* is also clear in evidence.
translations.idiomatic: Only Kaiyuan is somewhat near antiquity, and Chen's book is clear.

sentences.zh: 前享先農，既以佾數不足，降八爲六，則今祀先蠶，止用樂歌，不用樂舞，亦合古制。

translations.literal: Earlier, for the Spirit of Agriculture, because rows were insufficient eight were reduced to six; for the Sericulture Spirit now, using only song without dance also fits ancient regulation.
translations.idiomatic: For the Spirit of Agriculture rows were reduced from eight to six; for the Sericulture Spirit song without dance also fits ancient usage.

sentences.zh: 且以見少殺先農之禮。

translations.literal: " And this shows a slight reduction below the Spirit of Agriculture rite."
translations.idiomatic: This also marks a slight reduction below the Spirit of Agriculture rite."

sentences.zh: 」帝以舞非女子事，罷不用。

translations.literal: The emperor held that dance was not women's work and abolished its use.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held dance no woman's work and abolished it.

sentences.zh: 使議樂女冠服以聞。

translations.literal: He ordered deliberation on female musicians' caps and dress to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered deliberation on female musicians' dress to be reported.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「北郊陰方，其色尚黑。

translations.literal: The ritual officials said: "The northern suburb is the yin direction; its color favors black.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials said: "The northern suburb is yin; its color is black.

sentences.zh: 同色相感，事神之道。

translations.literal: Like color responds to like—this is the way of serving spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Like responds to like—such is serving spirits.

sentences.zh: 漢蠶東郊，魏蠶西郊，色皆尚青，非其色矣。

translations.literal: Han sericulture was east of the suburb, Wei west of the suburb—both favored green, not the proper color.
translations.idiomatic: Han placed sericulture east and Wei west, both favoring green—not the proper color.

sentences.zh: 樂女冠服宜黑。

translations.literal: Female musicians' caps and dress should be black.
translations.idiomatic: Female musicians should wear black.

sentences.zh: 」乃用樂六奏，去舞。

translations.literal: " Thus six musical performances were used, dance removed.
translations.idiomatic: Six performances were used, without dance.

sentences.zh: 其樂女皆黑冠服，因定享先蠶樂章。

translations.literal: The female musicians all wore black caps and dress, and hymns for offering to the Sericulture Spirit were thereby fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Female musicians wore black, and hymns for the Sericulture Spirit were fixed.

sentences.zh: 又以祀典方釐定南北郊，復朝日夕月之祭，命詞臣取洪武時舊樂歌，一切更改。

translations.literal: As the sacrificial canon was being sorted for southern and northern suburbs, the morning-sun and evening-moon sacrifices were restored; the emperor ordered literary officials to take Hongwu-era old hymns and change them entirely.
translations.idiomatic: As suburban rites were being sorted, morning-sun and evening-moon sacrifices were restored and Hongwu hymn texts ordered wholly revised.

sentences.zh: 禮官因請廣求博訪，有如宋胡瑗、李照者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: The ritual officials therefore asked for broad search and inquiry, reporting names such as Song Hu Yuan and Li Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials asked for broad search, naming men such as Song Hu Yuan and Li Zhao.

sentences.zh: 授之太常，考定雅樂。

translations.literal: They were given to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to examine and fix elegant music.
translations.idiomatic: They were to be given to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to fix court music.

sentences.zh: 給事中夏言乃以致仕甘肅行太僕寺丞張鶚應詔。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Xia Yan then presented retired Gansu Acting Grand Master of the Stud Zhang E in response to the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Xia Yan presented retired Zhang E of Gansu, Acting Grand Master of the Stud, in answer to the edict.

sentences.zh: 命趣召之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered him summoned urgently.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered him summoned at once.

sentences.zh: 既至，言曰：

translations.literal: When he arrived, he spoke:
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived he said:

sentences.zh: 大樂之正，乃先定元聲。

translations.literal: "The rectification of great music must first fix the primal sound.
translations.idiomatic: To rectify great music one must first fix the primal sound.

sentences.zh: 元聲起自冥罔既覺之時，亥子相乘之際。

translations.literal: The primal sound arises from the time when obscurity has just awakened, at the juncture when hai and zi multiply.
translations.idiomatic: It arises when darkness first stirs, at the meeting of hai and zi.

sentences.zh: 積絲成毫，積毫成釐，積釐成分。

translations.literal: Silk accumulates to form a hair's breadth, hairs to a li, li to a fen.
translations.idiomatic: Silk accumulates to a hair, hairs to a li, li to a fen.

sentences.zh: 一時三十分，一日十二時。

translations.literal: One shichen has thirty fen; one day has twelve shichen.
translations.idiomatic: One double-hour has thirty fen; one day has twelve double-hours.

sentences.zh: 故聲生於日，律起於辰。

translations.literal: Thus sound is born from the day; pitch arises from the double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Sound is born from the day; pitch arises from the double-hour.

sentences.zh: 氣在聲先，聲從氣後。

translations.literal: Qi precedes sound; sound follows qi.
translations.idiomatic: Breath precedes sound; sound follows breath.

sentences.zh: 若拘於器以求氣，則氣不能致器，而反受制於器，何以定黃鐘、起曆元？

translations.literal: If one is bound to instruments to seek qi, qi cannot master instruments but is instead mastered by them—how fix yellow bell and establish the calendar epoch?
translations.idiomatic: If one seeks breath only through instruments, breath cannot command them but is commanded by them—how fix yellow bell or establish the calendar epoch?

sentences.zh: 須依蔡元定，多截竹以擬黃鐘之律，長短每差一分。

translations.literal: One must follow Cai Yuanding: cut many bamboo tubes to approximate yellow-bell pitch, each a fen shorter or longer.
translations.idiomatic: Follow Cai Yuanding: cut many bamboo tubes approximating yellow bell, each differing by one fen.

sentences.zh: 冬至日按律而候，依法而取。

translations.literal: On the winter solstice test by pitch and wait; take according to rule.
translations.idiomatic: On the winter solstice test by pitch and take by rule.

sentences.zh: 如衆管中先飛灰者，即得元氣。

translations.literal: Whichever tube among many first shows flying ash—that is primal qi.
translations.idiomatic: Whichever tube first shows flying ash holds primal breath.

sentences.zh: 驗其時刻，如在子初二刻，即子初一刻移於初二刻矣；

translations.literal: Verify the moment: if at the beginning of zi, second quarter, then the beginning of zi, first quarter, shifts to the second quarter;
translations.idiomatic: Verify the moment: if ash flies at the beginning of zi, second quarter, the first quarter of zi shifts to the second;

sentences.zh: 如在正二刻，即子正一刻移於正二刻矣。

translations.literal: if at the exact second quarter, then the exact first quarter of zi shifts to the exact second quarter.
translations.idiomatic: if at the exact second quarter, the exact first quarter shifts to the exact second.

sentences.zh: 顧命知歷官一人，同臣參候，庶幾元聲可得，而古樂可復。

translations.literal: I would ask that one calendar official be appointed to join me in observation—perhaps the primal sound may be obtained and ancient music restored.
translations.idiomatic: Appoint one calendar official to join me in observation—then perhaps primal sound may be found and ancient music restored.

sentences.zh: 又言：

translations.literal: He also said:
translations.idiomatic: He also said:

sentences.zh: 古人制爲十六編鐘，非徒事觀美，蓋爲旋宮而設。

translations.literal: "The ancients made sixteen sets of suspended bells—not merely for display, but to enable rotation of modes.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients made sixteen bell sets—not for display but for rotating modes.

sentences.zh: 其下八鍾，黃鐘、大呂、太簇、夾鍾、姑洗、仲呂、蕤賓、林鐘是已；

translations.literal: The lower eight bells: yellow bell, great lü, great cluster, compressed bell, gu xian, zhong lü, flaccid guest, forest bell;
translations.idiomatic: The lower eight: yellow bell, great lü, great cluster, compressed bell, gu xian, zhong lü, flaccid guest, forest bell;

sentences.zh: 其上八鍾，夷則、南呂、無射、應鐘、黃鐘、大呂、太簇是已。

translations.literal: the upper eight bells: yi ze, southern lü, wu she, ying bell, yellow bell, great lü, great cluster.
translations.idiomatic: the upper eight: yi ze, southern lü, wu she, ying bell, yellow bell, great lü, great cluster.

sentences.zh: 近世止用黃鐘一均，而不遍具十六鍾，古人立樂之方已失。

translations.literal: Recent ages use only the yellow-bell key and do not fully equip sixteen bells—the ancients' method of establishing music is already lost.
translations.idiomatic: Recent ages use only the yellow-bell key and lack full sixteen bells—the ancient method is lost.

sentences.zh: 況太常止以五、凡、工、尺、上、一、四、六、勾、合字眼譜之，去古益遠。

translations.literal: Moreover the Court of Imperial Sacrifices notates only with the characters wu, fan, gong, chi, shang, yi, si, liu, gou, he—ever farther from antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: The Court notates only with gong, chi, and related solfège—farther still from antiquity.

sentences.zh: 且如黃鐘爲合似矣，其以大呂爲下四，太簇爲高四，夾鍾爲下一，姑洗爲高一，夷則爲下工，南呂爲高工之類，皆以兩律兼一字，何以旋宮取律，止黃鐘一均而已。

translations.literal: For example, yellow bell is like 'he'; great lü as lower si, great cluster as higher si, compressed bell as lower yi, gu xian as higher yi, yi ze as lower gong, southern lü as higher gong—each pairs two pitches in one character; how rotate modes and take pitch when only the yellow-bell key is used?
translations.idiomatic: Yellow bell is 'he'; great lü lower si, great cluster higher si, and so on—two pitches per sign—so how rotate modes when only yellow bell is used?

sentences.zh: 且黃鐘、大呂、太族、夾鍾爲上四清聲。

translations.literal: Moreover yellow bell, great lü, great cluster, and compressed bell are the upper four clear sounds.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow bell, great lü, great cluster, and compressed bell are the upper four clear tones.

sentences.zh: 蓋黃鐘爲君，至尊無比。

translations.literal: For yellow bell is sovereign, supreme beyond compare.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow bell is sovereign, beyond compare.

sentences.zh: 黃鐘爲宮，則十一律皆從而受制，臣民事物莫敢凌犯焉。

translations.literal: When yellow bell is gong, the eleven other pitches all follow and are constrained; subjects, people, and things dare not transgress.
translations.idiomatic: As gong, the eleven other pitches follow and are constrained; nothing dares transgress.

sentences.zh: 至於夾鍾爲宮，則下生無射爲徵，無射上生仲呂爲商，仲呂下生黃鐘爲羽。

translations.literal: When compressed bell is gong, wu she below generates yi ze as zhi, wu she above generates zhong lü as shang, zhong lü below generates yellow bell as yu.
translations.idiomatic: When compressed bell is gong, wu she generates yi ze as zhi and zhong lü as shang, and zhong lü generates yellow bell as yu.

sentences.zh: 然黃鐘正律聲長，非仲呂爲商三分去一之次。

translations.literal: Yet the full yellow-bell pitch is long—not the rank of zhong lü generating shang by subtracting one-third.
translations.idiomatic: Yet full yellow bell is long—not the rank of zhong lü generating shang by subtracting one-third.

sentences.zh: 所以用黃鐘爲羽，必用子聲，即上黃六之清聲，正爲不敢用黃鐘全聲，而用其半耳。

translations.literal: Therefore when yellow bell serves as yu, the child-tone must be used—that is, upper yellow on li as clear sound—precisely because one dare not use the full yellow-bell sound but only its half.
translations.idiomatic: So yellow bell as yu uses the child-tone, upper yellow-six clear sound—daring not the full tone but half only.

sentences.zh: 姑洗以下之均，大率若此。

translations.literal: Keys from gu xian downward are mostly like this.
translations.idiomatic: Keys from gu xian downward are mostly so.

sentences.zh: 此四清聲之所由立也。

translations.literal: Thus the four clear sounds are established.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the four clear tones are established.

sentences.zh: 編鐘十六，其理亦然。

translations.literal: Sixteen suspended bells—the principle is the same.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen bells follow the same principle.

sentences.zh: 宋胡瑗知此義，故四清聲皆小其圍徑以就之。

translations.literal: Song Hu Yuan knew this meaning, so the four clear sounds all had their circumference reduced to fit.
translations.idiomatic: Song Hu Yuan knew this and reduced the four clear tones' circumference.

sentences.zh: 然黃鐘、太簇二聲雖合，大呂、夾鍾二聲又非，遂使十二律、五聲皆不得正。

translations.literal: Yet though yellow bell and great cluster matched, great lü and compressed bell did not; thus the twelve pitches and five tones could not be correct.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow bell and great cluster matched, but great lü and compressed bell did not, and twelve pitches and five tones went wrong.

sentences.zh: 至於李照、範鎮止用十二律，不用四清聲，其合於三分損益者則和矣。

translations.literal: As for Li Zhao and Fan Zhen, using only twelve pitches without the four clear sounds, what matched the three-part increase and decrease was harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhao and Fan Zhen used only twelve pitches without the four clear tones; what matched three-part increase and decrease was harmonious.

sentences.zh: 夷則以降，其臣民事物，安能尊卑有辨，而不相凌犯耶？

translations.literal: From yi ze downward, how could subjects, people, and things distinguish high and low and not transgress one another?
translations.idiomatic: From yi ze downward, how could rank be kept and nothing transgress?

sentences.zh: 臣又考《周禮》，圜鍾、函鍾、黃鐘、天地人三宮之說，有薦神之樂，有降神之樂。

translations.literal: Your servant has also examined *Rites of Zhou*: round bell, envelope bell, yellow bell—the theory of the three palaces of Heaven, Earth, and Man; there is music for presenting to spirits and music for descending spirits.
translations.idiomatic: I have examined *Rites of Zhou*: round bell, envelope bell, yellow bell—the three palaces of Heaven, Earth, and Man; music for presenting spirits and music for descending spirits.

sentences.zh: 所爲薦神之樂者，乃奏黃鐘，歌大呂，子醜合也，舞《雲門》以祀天神。

translations.literal: Music for presenting spirits: perform yellow bell, sing great lü—zi and chou unite; dance *Cloud Gate* to sacrifice to the Heavenly Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting spirits: perform yellow bell, sing great lü—zi and chou unite; dance *Cloud Gate* for the Heavenly Spirit.

sentences.zh: 乃奏太簇，歌應鐘，寅亥合也，舞《咸池》以祀地祇。

translations.literal: Perform great cluster, sing ying bell—yin and hai unite; dance *Xianchi* to sacrifice to earthly spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Perform great cluster, sing ying bell—yin and hai unite; dance *Xian Pool* for earthly spirits.

sentences.zh: 乃奏姑洗，歌南呂，辰酉合也，舞《大韶》以祭四望。

translations.literal: Perform gu xian, sing southern lü—chen and you unite; dance *Great Shao* to sacrifice to the four expanses.
translations.idiomatic: Perform gu xian, sing southern lü—chen and you unite; dance *Great Shao* for the four expanses.

sentences.zh: 乃奏蕤賓，歌林鐘，午未合也，舞《大夏》以祭山川。

translations.literal: Perform flaccid guest, sing forest bell—wu and wei unite; dance *Great Xia* to sacrifice to mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Perform flaccid guest, sing forest bell—wu and wei unite; dance *Great Xia* for mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 乃奏夷則，歌小呂，巳申合也，舞《大武》以享先祖，舞《大濩》以享先妣。

translations.literal: Perform yi ze, sing lesser lü—si and shen unite; dance *Great Martial* to honor ancestors, dance *Great Huo* to honor the ancestral mother.
translations.idiomatic: Perform yi ze, sing lesser lü—si and shen unite; dance *Great Martial* for ancestors and *Great Huo* for the ancestral mother.

sentences.zh: 所謂降神之樂者，冬至祀天圜丘，則以圜鍾爲宮，黃鐘爲角，太簇爲徵，姑洗爲羽，是三者陽律相繼。

translations.literal: What is called music for descending spirits: at the winter solstice sacrificing to Heaven at the round mound, round bell serves as gong, yellow bell as jue, great cluster as zhi, gu xian as yu—these three are yang pitches in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Music for descending spirits: at winter solstice on the round mound, round bell is gong, yellow bell jue, great cluster zhi, gu xian yu—three yang pitches in succession.

sentences.zh: 相繼者，天之道也。

translations.literal: Succession is Heaven's way.
translations.idiomatic: Succession is Heaven's way.

sentences.zh: 夏至祭地方丘，則以函鍾爲宮，夾鍾爲角，姑洗爲徵，南呂爲羽，是三者陰呂相生。

translations.literal: At the summer solstice sacrificing to Earth at the square mound, envelope bell serves as gong, compressed bell as jue, gu xian as zhi, southern lü as yu—these three are yin lü generating one another.
translations.idiomatic: At summer solstice on the square mound, envelope bell is gong, compressed bell jue, gu xian zhi, southern lü yu—three yin lü generating one another.

sentences.zh: 相生者，地之功也。

translations.literal: Generation is Earth's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Generation is Earth's work.

sentences.zh: 祭宗廟，以黃鐘爲宮，大呂爲角，太簇爲徵，夾鍾爲羽，是三者律呂相合。

translations.literal: Sacrificing at the ancestral temple, yellow bell serves as gong, great lü as jue, great cluster as zhi, compressed bell as yu—these three are lü and pitch united.
translations.idiomatic: At the ancestral temple, yellow bell is gong, great lü jue, great cluster zhi, compressed bell yu—lü and pitch united.

sentences.zh: 相合者，人之情也。

translations.literal: Union is human feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Union is human feeling.

sentences.zh: 且圜鍾，夾鍾也。

translations.literal: Moreover round bell is compressed bell.
translations.idiomatic: Round bell is compressed bell.

sentences.zh: 生於房心之氣，爲天地之明堂，祀天從此起宮，在琴中角弦第十徽，卯位也。

translations.literal: Born of the qi of the Heart and Room asterisms, it is the Bright Hall of Heaven and Earth; sacrifice to Heaven takes gong from here—in the zither, the jue string at the tenth stud, mao position.
translations.idiomatic: Born of Heart-and-Room qi, it is Heaven and Earth's Bright Hall; sacrifice to Heaven starts gong here—on the zither, jue string, tenth stud, mao position.

sentences.zh: 函鍾，林鐘也。

translations.literal: Envelope bell is forest bell.
translations.idiomatic: Envelope bell is forest bell.

sentences.zh: 生於坤位之氣，在井東輿鬼之外，主地祇，祭地從此起宮，在琴中徽弦第五徽，未位也。

translations.literal: Born of the qi of the kun position, beyond the Well east of the Chariot and Ghost asterisms, it governs earthly spirits; sacrifice to Earth takes gong from here—in the zither, the hui string at the fifth stud, wei position.
translations.idiomatic: Born of kun-position qi, beyond Well east of Chariot and Ghost, it governs earthly spirits; sacrifice to Earth starts gong here—hui string, fifth stud, wei position.

sentences.zh: 黃鐘，生於虛危之氣，爲宗廟，祭人鬼從此起宮，在琴中宮弦第三徽，子位也。

translations.literal: Yellow bell is born of the qi of the Void and Danger asterisms, is the ancestral temple; sacrifice to human ghosts takes gong from here—in the zither, the gong string at the third stud, zi position.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow bell is born of Void-and-Danger qi, is the ancestral temple; sacrifice to human ghosts starts gong here—gong string, third stud, zi position.

sentences.zh: 至若六變而天神降，八變而地祇格，九變而人鬼享，非有難易之分。

translations.literal: As for six changes and the Heavenly Spirit descends, eight changes and earthly spirits arrive, nine changes and human ghosts enjoy—there is no difference of difficulty.
translations.idiomatic: Six changes and the Heavenly Spirit descends, eight and earthly spirits arrive, nine and human ghosts enjoy—not because one is harder than another.

sentences.zh: 蓋陽數起子而終於少陰之申，陰數起午而終於少陽之寅。

translations.literal: For yang numbers begin at zi and end at lesser yin's shen; yin numbers begin at wu and end at lesser yang's yin.
translations.idiomatic: Yang numbers run from zi to lesser yin's shen; yin from wu to lesser yang's yin.

sentences.zh: 圜鍾在卯，自卯至申六數，故六變而天神降。

translations.literal: Round bell is at mao; from mao to shen is six counts—thus six changes and the Heavenly Spirit descends.
translations.idiomatic: Round bell stands at mao; mao to shen is six—hence six changes and Heaven descends.

sentences.zh: 函鍾在未，自未至寅八數，故八變而地祇格。

translations.literal: Envelope bell is at wei; from wei to yin is eight counts—thus eight changes and earthly spirits arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Envelope bell at wei; wei to yin is eight—hence eight changes and earth arrives.

sentences.zh: 黃鐘在子，自子至申九數，故九變而人鬼享。

translations.literal: Yellow bell is at zi; from zi to shen is nine counts—thus nine changes and human ghosts enjoy.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow bell at zi; zi to shen is nine—hence nine changes and the dead are feasted.

sentences.zh: 此皆以本元之聲，召本位之神，故感通之理速也。

translations.literal: All use the sound of the primal origin to summon the spirit of the native position—thus the principle of sympathetic response is swift.
translations.idiomatic: Each uses its primal tone to summon its native spirit—so response is swift.

sentences.zh: 或者謂自漢以來，天地鬼神聞新聲習矣，何必改作。

translations.literal: Some say that since Han, Heaven, Earth, and spirits have grown used to new sounds—why revise?
translations.idiomatic: Some say that since Han the spirits have grown used to new sounds—why change?

sentences.zh: 不知自人觀天地，則由漢迄今千七百年；

translations.literal: Viewed by men, from Han to today is one thousand seven hundred years;
translations.idiomatic: From man's view, Han to today is one thousand seven hundred years;

sentences.zh: 自天地觀，亦頃刻間耳。

translations.literal: viewed by Heaven and Earth, it is but an instant.
translations.idiomatic: from Heaven and Earth's view, but an instant.

sentences.zh: 自今正之，猶可及也。

translations.literal: To correct from today is still in time.
translations.idiomatic: To correct from today is still in time.

sentences.zh: 並進所著樂書二部。

translations.literal: He also presented two works on music he had authored.
translations.idiomatic: He also presented two music books he had written.

sentences.zh: 其一曰《大成樂舞圖譜》，自琴瑟以下諸樂，逐字作譜。

translations.literal: One titled *Dacheng yuewu tupu*, giving character-by-character notation from zither and se downward for all music.
translations.idiomatic: One, *Complete Chart of Music and Dance*, notating every instrument from zither and se downward.

sentences.zh: 其一曰《古雅心談》，列十二圖以象十二律。

translations.literal: One titled *Guya xintan*, arranging twelve diagrams to represent the twelve pitches.
translations.idiomatic: One, *Heart Discourse on Ancient Elegance*, with twelve diagrams for the twelve pitches.

sentences.zh: 圖各有說。

translations.literal: Each diagram had its explanation.
translations.idiomatic: Each diagram had its explanation.

sentences.zh: 又以琴爲正聲，樂之宗系。

translations.literal: He also took the zither as correct sound, the lineage of music.
translations.idiomatic: He held the zither the correct sound and root of music.

sentences.zh: 凡郊廟大樂，分注琴絃定徽，各有歸旨。

translations.literal: For all suburban and temple great music, he annotated zither strings and fixed studs, each with its proper aim.
translations.idiomatic: For suburban and temple music he marked zither strings and studs, each with its proper aim.

sentences.zh: 且自謂心所獨契，斫輪之妙，有非口所能言者。

translations.literal: He claimed a private accord of the heart, the secret of the wheelwright—not what the mouth can speak.
translations.idiomatic: He claimed a private accord beyond words, like the wheelwright's secret craft.

sentences.zh: 疏下禮部。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「音律久廢，太常諸官循習工尺譜，不復知有黃鐘等調。

translations.literal: The ritual officials said: "Pitch and mode have long been abandoned; Court of Imperial Sacrifices officers follow only gong-chi notation and no longer know yellow bell and other keys.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials replied: "Pitch has long been lost; Court officers follow only gong-chi notation and no longer know yellow bell.

sentences.zh: 臣等近奉詔演習新定郊祀樂章，間問古人遺制，茫無以對。

translations.literal: We have recently received orders to drill the newly fixed suburban hymn texts; when we asked about ancient remains, we had nothing to answer.
translations.idiomatic: We were recently ordered to drill new suburban hymns; asked about ancient practice, we could not answer.

sentences.zh: 今鶚謂四清聲所以爲旋宮，其注弦定徽，蓋已深識近樂之弊。

translations.literal: Now E says the four clear sounds enable rotation of modes; his marking strings and studs shows he deeply knows the faults of recent music.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang E's four clear tones and string markings show he knows recent music's faults.

sentences.zh: 至欲取知歷者，互相參考，尤爲探本窮源之論。

translations.literal: As for seeking calendar experts for mutual reference, this is especially a theory that probes root and source.
translations.idiomatic: His wish to join calendar experts in testing probes to the root.

sentences.zh: 似非目前司樂者所及。

translations.literal: It seems beyond what present music officers can reach."
translations.idiomatic: It seems beyond present music officers."

sentences.zh: 」乃授鶚太常寺丞，令詣太和殿較定樂舞。

translations.literal: " E was then appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and ordered to the Hall of Supreme Harmony to examine and fix music and dance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang E was made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and sent to the Hall of Supreme Harmony to fix music and dance.

sentences.zh: 鶚遂上言：「《周禮》有郊祀之樂，有宗祀之樂。

translations.literal: E then submitted: "*Rites of Zhou* has suburban-sacrifice music and ancestral-temple music.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang E then wrote: "*Rites of Zhou* distinguishes suburban music from temple music.

sentences.zh: 尊親分殊，聲律自別。

translations.literal: Honor to parents differs in degree; sound and mode differ of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Honor to parents differs; sound and mode must differ.

sentences.zh: 臣伏聽世廟樂章，律起林鐘，均殊太廟。

translations.literal: Your servant has listened to the World Temple hymns: the mode begins at forest bell, the key differing from the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard the World Temple hymns begin at forest bell, not the Grand Temple key.

sentences.zh: 臣竊異之。

translations.literal: Your servant finds this strange.
translations.idiomatic: I find this strange.

sentences.zh: 蓋世廟與太廟同禮，而林鐘與黃鐘異樂。

translations.literal: For the World Temple and Grand Temple share the same rite, yet forest bell and yellow bell differ in music.
translations.idiomatic: World Temple and Grand Temple share one rite, yet forest bell and yellow bell differ.

sentences.zh: 函鍾主祀地祇，位寓坤方，星分井鬼，樂奏八變，以報資生之功。

translations.literal: Envelope bell governs sacrifice to earthly spirits, its position in the kun direction, stars in Well and Ghost, music with eight changes to repay the work of nourishing life.
translations.idiomatic: Envelope bell governs earth, in kun, stars Well and Ghost, eight changes to repay nourishing life.

sentences.zh: 故用林鐘起調，林鐘畢調也。

translations.literal: Therefore forest bell opens the mode and forest bell closes the mode.
translations.idiomatic: So forest bell opens and closes that mode.

sentences.zh: 黃鐘主祀宗廟，位分子野，星隸虛危，樂奏九成，以報本源之德。

translations.literal: Yellow bell governs the ancestral temple, position in the asterism field, stars in Void and Danger, music with nine accomplishments to repay the virtue of the root source.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow bell governs the ancestral temple, stars Void and Danger, nine accomplishments for the root virtue.

sentences.zh: 故用黃鐘起調，黃鐘畢調也。

translations.literal: Therefore yellow bell opens the mode and yellow bell closes the mode.
translations.idiomatic: So yellow bell opens and closes its mode.

sentences.zh: 理義各有歸旨，聲數默相感通。

translations.literal: Principle and meaning each have their aim; sound and number silently respond to one another.
translations.idiomatic: Principle has its aim; sound and number respond in silence.

sentences.zh: 況天地者父母之象，大君者宗子之稱。

translations.literal: Moreover Heaven and Earth are the image of parents; the great lord is called the eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and Earth image parents; the emperor is the eldest son.

sentences.zh: 今以祀母之樂，奏以祀子，恐世廟在天之靈，必不能安且享矣。

translations.literal: Now to perform music for sacrificing to the mother when sacrificing to the son—I fear the World Temple spirit in Heaven could not rest and enjoy.
translations.idiomatic: To play the mother's music when sacrificing to the son—I fear the World Temple spirit in Heaven cannot rest and enjoy.

sentences.zh: 不知譜是樂者，何所見也。

translations.literal: Those who scored this music—what did they see?
translations.idiomatic: Who scored this music—and on what grounds?

sentences.zh: 臣觀舊譜樂章，字用黃鐘，聲同太廟。

translations.literal: Your servant views the old score: the characters use yellow bell, the sound matches the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The old score uses yellow-bell signs but sounds like the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 但審聽七聲，中少一律，今更補正。

translations.literal: But on careful hearing of the seven tones, one pitch is missing; now it is supplemented and corrected.
translations.idiomatic: On careful hearing one pitch is missing; I have corrected it.

sentences.zh: 使依奏格，則祖孫一氣相爲流通，函黃二宮不失均調。

translations.literal: If performed according to the score, then grandfather and grandson share one breath in circulation; envelope and yellow, the two gong modes, do not lose balanced tuning.
translations.idiomatic: Performed as scored, grandfather and grandson share one breath; envelope and yellow gong keep their balance.

sentences.zh: 尊親之分兩得，神人之心胥悅矣。

translations.literal: The distinction of honor to parents is secured on both sides; the hearts of spirits and men are all pleased."
translations.idiomatic: Honor to parents is secured; spirits and men alike are pleased."

sentences.zh: 」詔下禮官。

translations.literal: An edict was sent to the ritual officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict went to the ritual officials.

sentences.zh: 李時等覆奏，以爲：「鶚所言，與臣等所聞於律呂諸書者，深有所合。

translations.literal: Li Shi and others replied, holding that: "What E said agrees deeply with what we have heard in books on lü and pitch.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi and others replied that Zhang E agreed with books on pitch they had read.

sentences.zh: 蓋黃鐘一調，以黃鐘爲宮，太簇爲商，姑洗爲角，蕤賓爲變徵，林鐘爲徵，南呂爲羽，應鐘爲變宮。

translations.literal: For the yellow-bell key, yellow bell is gong, great cluster is shang, gu xian is jue, flaccid guest is altered zhi, forest bell is zhi, southern lü is yu, ying bell is altered gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the yellow-bell key: yellow bell gong, great cluster shang, gu xian jue, flaccid guest altered zhi, forest bell zhi, southern lü yu, ying bell altered gong.

sentences.zh: 舊樂章用合，用四，用一，用尺，用工。

translations.literal: The old hymns used he, si, yi, chi, gong.
translations.idiomatic: Old hymns used he, si, yi, chi, gong.

sentences.zh: 去蕤賓之勾，而越次用再生黃鐘之六，此舊樂章之失也。

translations.literal: They removed flaccid guest's gou and out of order used regenerated yellow bell's liu—this was the old hymns' fault.
translations.idiomatic: They dropped flaccid guest's gou and wrongly used regenerated yellow bell's liu—that was the old fault.

sentences.zh: 若林鐘一調，則以林鐘爲宮，南呂爲商，應鐘爲角，大呂之半聲爲變徵，太簇之半聲爲徵，姑洗之半聲爲羽，蕤賓之半聲爲變宮。

translations.literal: If the forest-bell key, then forest bell is gong, southern lü is shang, ying bell is jue, great lü's half-tone is altered zhi, great cluster's half-tone is zhi, gu xian's half-tone is yu, flaccid guest's half-tone is altered gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the forest-bell key: forest bell gong, southern lü shang, ying bell jue, great lü half-tone altered zhi, great cluster half-tone zhi, gu xian half-tone yu, flaccid guest half-tone altered gong.

sentences.zh: 邇者沈居敬更協樂章，用尺，用合，用四，用一，用工，用六。

translations.literal: Recently Shen Jujing revised the hymns, using chi, he, si, yi, gong, liu.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Shen Jujing used chi, he, si, yi, gong, liu.

sentences.zh: 夫合，黃鐘也；

translations.literal: He is yellow bell;
translations.idiomatic: He is yellow bell;

sentences.zh: 四，太簇之正聲也；

translations.literal: si is great cluster's full tone;
translations.idiomatic: si is great cluster's full tone;

sentences.zh: 一，姑洗之正聲也；

translations.literal: yi is gu xian's full tone;
translations.idiomatic: yi is gu xian's full tone;

sentences.zh: 六，黃鐘之子聲也。

translations.literal: liu is yellow bell's child-tone.
translations.idiomatic: liu is yellow bell's child-tone.

sentences.zh: 以林鐘爲宮，而所用爲角徵羽者，皆非其一均之聲，則謬甚矣。

translations.literal: Taking forest bell as gong while the jue, zhi, and yu used are none of its key's sounds—the error is extreme.
translations.idiomatic: With forest bell as gong, the jue, zhi, and yu used are not of that key—the error is extreme.

sentences.zh: 況林鐘一調，不宜用於宗廟，而太廟與世廟，不宜異調，鶚見尤真。

translations.literal: Moreover the forest-bell key should not be used in the ancestral temple; Grand Temple and World Temple should not differ in key—E's view is especially true.
translations.idiomatic: The forest-bell key should not serve the temple; Grand and World Temples should not differ—Zhang E is especially right.

sentences.zh: 自今宜用舊協音律，惟加以蕤賓勾聲，去再生黃鐘之六，改用應鐘之凡，以成黃鐘一均，庶於感格之義，深有所補。」

translations.literal: From now the old harmonized pitch should be used, only adding flaccid guest's gou sound, removing regenerated yellow bell's liu, and using ying bell's fan instead, to complete the yellow-bell key—perhaps the meaning of sympathetic response will be deeply aided."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter use the old harmony, add flaccid guest's gou, drop regenerated liu, use ying bell's fan, to complete the yellow-bell key and aid sympathetic response."

sentences.zh: 乃命鶚更定廟享樂音，而逮治沈居敬等。

translations.literal: E was ordered to revise temple-offering music and punish Shen Jujing and others.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang E was ordered to revise temple music and punish Shen Jujing and others.

sentences.zh: 鶚尋譜定帝社稷樂歌以進。

translations.literal: E soon scored the emperor's soil-and-grain hymns and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: He soon scored the emperor's soil-and-grain hymns and presented them.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其勤，晉爲少卿，掌教雅樂。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his diligence, promoted him to Vice Minister, and put him in charge of teaching elegant music.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his diligence, made him Vice Minister, and put him in charge of court music.

sentences.zh: 夏言又引古者龍見而雩，命樂正習盛樂，舞皇舞。

translations.literal: Xia Yan again cited that in antiquity when the dragon appeared they prayed for rain, ordering the Director of Music to drill abundant music and dance the imperial dance.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yan cited antiquity: when the dragon appeared, rain was prayed and the Director of Music drilled abundant music and the imperial dance.

sentences.zh: 請依古禮，定大雩之制。

translations.literal: He asked to follow ancient rites and fix the great rain-prayer regulation.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to fix the great rain-prayer by ancient rite.

sentences.zh: 當三獻禮成之後，九奏樂止之時，皛括《雲漢》詩辭，製爲《雲門》一曲，使文武舞士並舞而合歌之。

translations.literal: When the three offerings were complete and the nine performances ended, distill the words of the *Clouds* ode into one *Cloud Gate* piece, making civil and martial dancers dance together and sing in unison.
translations.idiomatic: When three offerings and nine performances ended, distill the *Clouds* ode into one *Cloud Gate*, civil and martial dancers dancing and singing together.

sentences.zh: 帝可其議。

translations.literal: The emperor approved the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 時七廟既建，樂制未備，禮官因請更定宗廟雅樂，言：「德、懿、熙、仁四祖久祧，舊章弗協。

translations.literal: At that time the seven temples were built but music regulations were not complete; ritual officials therefore asked to revise ancestral-temple elegant music, saying: "The four ancestors De, Yi, Xi, and Ren have long been distant; old regulations do not accord.
translations.idiomatic: The seven temples stood but music was incomplete; ritual officials asked to revise temple music, saying the four distant ancestors De, Yi, Xi, and Ren no longer matched old rules.

sentences.zh: 太祖創業，太宗定鼎，列聖守成。

translations.literal: The founding emperor created the enterprise; the Taizong emperor secured the tripod; successive sages preserved the achievement.
translations.idiomatic: The founder created the enterprise; Taizong secured the realm; successive sages preserved it.

sentences.zh: 當有頌聲，以對越在天，垂之萬蜺。

translations.literal: There should be praise-sounds to face Heaven above and extend to ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Praise should face Heaven and extend ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 若特享，若祫享，若大祫，詩歌頌美，宜命儒臣撰述，取自上裁。

translations.literal: For special offerings, combined offerings, and great combined offerings, hymns of praise should be composed by order of Confucian officials, taken from the emperor's decision.
translations.idiomatic: For special, combined, and great combined offerings, scholars should compose praise hymns for the emperor's decision.

sentences.zh: 其樂器、樂舞、各依太廟成式，備爲規制。

translations.literal: Instruments and dances should each follow the Grand Temple established form and be fully regulated."
translations.idiomatic: Instruments and dances should follow the Grand Temple pattern and be fully set."

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: The decree was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 已而尊獻帝爲睿宗，祔享太廟。

translations.literal: Later the deceased emperor was honored as Ruizong and enshrined in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Later the deceased emperor was honored as Ruizong and enshrined in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 於是九廟春特、三時祫、季冬大祫樂章，皆更定焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon hymns for spring special offerings of the nine temples, three seasonal combined offerings, and winter great combined offerings were all revised.
translations.idiomatic: Then hymns for the nine temples' spring specials, three seasonal combined offerings, and winter great combined offerings were all revised.

sentences.zh: 十八年巡狩興都，帝親制樂章，享上帝于飛龍殿，奉皇考配。

translations.literal: In year 18 the emperor toured Xingdu; he personally composed hymns, sacrificing to the Supreme Lord at the Flying Dragon Hall with his deceased father as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 on tour at Xingdu he composed hymns, sacrificing to the Supreme Lord at Flying Dragon Hall with his father as associate.

sentences.zh: 其後，七廟火，復同堂之制，四時歲祫，樂章器物仍如舊制。

translations.literal: Later the seven temples burned; the shared-hall system was restored; four-season yearly combined offerings—hymns, instruments, and objects remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: After the seven temples burned, the shared-hall system returned; four-season offerings kept old hymns and instruments.

sentences.zh: 初增七廟樂官及樂舞生，自四郊九廟暨太歲神祇諸壇，樂舞人數至二千一百名。

translations.literal: At first music officers and dance students for the seven temples were increased; from the four suburbs, nine temples, and Grand Year spirit altars, dancers reached two thousand one hundred persons.
translations.idiomatic: Music officers and dancers were first increased to two thousand one hundred for suburbs, temples, and spirit altars.

sentences.zh: 後稍裁革，存其半。

translations.literal: Later they were slightly cut; half remained.
translations.idiomatic: Later they were cut to half.

sentences.zh: 張鶚遷太常卿，復申前說，建白三事：一請設特鍾、特磬以爲樂節；

translations.literal: Zhang E was transferred to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and again stated his earlier views, memorializing three matters: first, to set special bells and special chime-stones as music markers;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang E became Director and again proposed three things: special bells and chime-stones as markers;

sentences.zh: 一請復宮縣以備古制；

translations.literal: second, to restore palace bells to complete the ancient system;
translations.idiomatic: restore palace bells for the ancient system;

sentences.zh: 一請候元氣以定鐘律。

translations.literal: third, to await primal qi to fix bell pitch.
translations.idiomatic: await primal breath to fix bell pitch.

sentences.zh: 事下禮官，言：「特鍾、特磬宜造樂懸，在廟廷中，周旋未便，不得更制。

translations.literal: The matter was sent to ritual officials, who said: "Special bells and special chime-stones should be made on the music frame; in the temple court, movement is inconvenient and they cannot be newly made.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials said special bells and stones should hang on the frame but temple movement was awkward and they could not be newly made.

sentences.zh: 惟黃鐘爲聲氣之元，候氣之法，實求中氣以定中聲，最爲作樂本原。

translations.literal: Only yellow bell is the origin of sound and breath; the method of awaiting qi truly seeks central qi to fix central sound—most fundamental for making music.
translations.idiomatic: Only yellow bell is sound's origin; awaiting qi seeks central breath for central tone—the root of music.

sentences.zh: 其說，若重室墐戶，截管實灰，覆緹，按歷氣至灰飛，證以累黍，具有成法可依。

translations.literal: The method: if one builds a heavy room, seals doors, cuts tubes and fills with ash, covers with silk, when calendar qi arrives the ash flies—verified by accumulated millet—there is established law to follow.
translations.idiomatic: The method: sealed heavy room, tubes filled with ash, silk cover, when qi arrives ash flies—verified by millet measures—has established law.

sentences.zh: 其法，築室於圜丘外垣隙地，選知歷候者往相其役，待稍有次第，然後委官考驗。

translations.literal: The method: build a room in open ground outside the round mound outer wall, select one who knows calendar and awaiting to oversee the work; when somewhat in order, then commission officials to verify.
translations.idiomatic: Build a room outside the round mound wall, appoint a calendar expert to oversee, then officials to verify.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 仍詔取山西長子縣羊頭山黍，大小中三等各五斗，以備候氣定律。

translations.literal: Still ordered millet of large, medium, and small grades, five dou each, taken from Yangtou Mountain in Changzi County, Shanxi, to prepare for awaiting qi and fixing law.
translations.idiomatic: Millet large, medium, and small, five dou each, was ordered from Yangtou Mountain, Changzi, Shanxi, for awaiting qi.

sentences.zh: 明自太祖、世宗，樂章屢易，然鐘律爲製作之要，未能有所講明。

translations.literal: From the founding emperor and Shizong, hymns were often changed, yet bell pitch, the crux of production, could not be clarified.
translations.idiomatic: From founder to Shizong hymns changed often, yet bell pitch—the crux—was never clarified.

sentences.zh: 呂懷、劉濂、韓邦奇、黃佐、王邦直之徒著書甚備，職不與典樂，託之空言而已。

translations.literal: Lü Huai, Liu Lian, Han Bangqi, Huang Zuo, Wang Bangzhi, and others wrote books in great detail, but their posts were not in charge of music—they remained empty words.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Huai, Liu Lian, Han Bangqi, Huang Zuo, Wang Bangzhi wrote fully but held no music office—their work remained words.

sentences.zh: 張鶚雖因知樂得官，候氣終屬渺茫，不能准以定律。

translations.literal: Though Zhang E gained office through knowing music, awaiting qi in the end belonged to the vague and could not be applied to fix pitch.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang E gained office through music, but awaiting qi stayed vague and could not fix pitch.

sentences.zh: 弘治中，莆人李教授文利，著《律呂元聲》，獨宗《呂覽》黃鐘三寸九分之說。

translations.literal: In the Hongzhi reign, Li Wenli, a Putian professor, wrote *Lülü yuansheng*, adhering alone to *Lüshi chunqiu*'s theory of yellow bell three cun nine fen.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi, Putian professor Li Wenli wrote *Primal Sounds of Pitch*, holding alone to *Spring and Autumn of Master Lü* on yellow bell at three cun nine fen.

sentences.zh: 世宗初年，御史範永鑾上其書，其說與古背，不可用。

translations.literal: In the early Jiajing reign, Censor Fan Yongquan presented his book; its theory opposed antiquity and could not be used.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiajing, Censor Fan Yongquan presented the book; its theory opposed antiquity and was rejected.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十七年六月，遼州同知李文察進所著樂書四種，禮官謂於樂理樂書多前人所未發者。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Jiajing year 17, Tongzhi of Liaozhou Li Wenchao presented four works on music he had authored; ritual officials said that in music theory and music books much had been opened that predecessors had not.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Jiajing year 17, Liaozhou Vice Prefect Li Wenchao presented four music books; ritual officials said they opened much predecessors had not.

sentences.zh: 乃授文察爲太常典簿，以獎勸之。

translations.literal: Wenchao was appointed Recorder of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to encourage him.
translations.idiomatic: Wenchao was made Recorder of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices as encouragement.

sentences.zh: 而其所云：「按人聲以考定五音。

translations.literal: But what he said—"determine the five tones by examining human voice.
translations.idiomatic: But his claim to "determine the five tones from the human voice"

sentences.zh: 」者，不能行也。

translations.literal: "—could not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: could not be carried out.

sentences.zh: 神宗時，鄭世子載堉著《律呂精義》、《律學新說》、《樂舞全譜》共若干卷，具表進獻。

translations.literal: In the Shenzong reign, the Prince of Zheng, Zaiyu, authored *Essence of Pitch and Mode*, *New Discourse on Pitch Studies*, and *Complete Chart of Music and Dance* in several volumes, presenting them all by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shenzong, Prince of Zheng Zaiyu wrote *Essence of Pitch*, *New Discourse on Pitch*, and *Complete Chart of Music and Dance* and presented them by memorial.

sentences.zh: 崇禎六年，禮部尚書黃汝良進《昭代樂律志》。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Chongzhen, Minister of Rites Huang Ruliang presented *Record of Music and Pitch of the Illustrious Age*.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen year 6, Minister Huang Ruliang presented *Record of Music and Pitch of the Illustrious Age*.

sentences.zh: 宣付史館，以備稽考，未及施行。

translations.literal: It was ordered delivered to the Historiography Office for reference and investigation; it was not put into practice in time.
translations.idiomatic: It was sent to the Historiography Office for reference but was not enacted in time.
